d: Massive protests rocking Bangladesh once again. This time, the unrest is driven by thousands of garment and textile workers who have taken over the streets of Dhaka and other major cities. Facing severe inflation and a rising cost of living, the workers are demanding a massive minimum wage hike from 12,000 Taka to 30,000 Taka. As a result of these intense demonstrations, over 500 clothing factories were temporarily shut down, posing a direct threat to the Bangladesh economy and its vital export sector.
